name: first-shift
description: A stylized 3D game that trains new waiters while teaching a foreign language.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && vite build
scripts.build:file: npm run audio:manifest && vite build --config vite.single.config.ts && node scripts/rename-single.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build:file && cd server && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:setup: cd server && wrangler d1 execute first-shift --remote --file=schema.sql
scripts.server:local: npm run build:file && cd server && wrangler d1 execute first-shift --local --file=schema.sql && wrangler dev
